verdict.rationale: Termius's documented automation is triggered by the user: snippets run on demand across hosts, startup snippets fire when the user connects, and broadcast and workspace templates replay sessions the user opens. None of that is a user-configured automation that runs autonomously in the background. Automatic log recording and cloud instance sync are built-in product behaviors, not automations the user sets up, so they earn no credit. The evidence shows no scheduling, background jobs or autonomous agent runs.
